corpus: benchmark/w0/corpus (26 public documents + 25 synthetic; see fetch_corpus.sh and make_synthetic.py)
note: Ground truth was read from the documents themselves. `expect` lists strings; an answer scores correct if it contains any of them (numbers are written as the documents write them). `source` is the file whose passage should be cited. `unanswerable` questions must be refused.
